case.summary: An investigation was triggered by a bank model risk score of 0.87 on the flagged transaction. It was assumed the customer made the transaction because no graph evidence beyond the alert pointed to fraud. The decisive evidence was the customer's direct confirmation that they made the transaction. Consequently, the verdict is legitimate and the case is closed with no fraud, following Fraud Policy R3 which dictates recommending CLOSE_NO_FRAUD and noting the confirmation when a customer confirms the transaction.
